property.name: lookupValue
property.description-key: The lookup field this control replaces. Place this control directly on that field.

property.name: iconColumnName
property.description-key: Optional: logical name of a column on the target table to render as an icon on each record option. Point this at an Image column to show that picture, a text column containing an MDL2 icon name to show that icon, or a Choice (option set) column whose selected option label is either an MDL2 icon name or a web resource file name (e.g. logo.png) - all detected automatically from the column type. Every name entered here must be a real column on the target table - use Fixed Icon Name instead for a literal icon shown on every record. Semicolon-separate multiple names (col1;col2) to try them in order per record - the first one with a value wins.

property.name: iconFixedName
property.description-key: Optional: a literal MDL2 icon name shown as the icon for any record where Icon Column produced no value - or for every record, if Icon Column is left blank entirely. Tried last, after every column in Icon Column has already been tried and come up empty.

property.name: iconShape
property.description-key: Shape drawn behind each record icon or picture. Full fills the icons square box edge to edge (default). Rounded Square uses a small corner radius. Circle fully rounds it. None applies no shape or background at all, regardless of Icon Background Color.

value.name: Full
value.description-key: Square box, fills edge to edge (default)

value.name: None
value.description-key: No shape or background - icon or picture rendered with no box

property.name: iconBackgroundColor
property.description-key: Optional: hex color (e.g. #0078D4) painted behind each record icon or picture, in the shape set by Icon Shape. Blank by default - no background is drawn. Ignored when Icon Shape is None.

property.name: iconColor
property.description-key: Optional: hex color (e.g. #0078D4) applied to MDL2 icon glyphs shown as each records icon. Blank by default - the icon renders in its natural color. Ignored for picture/web-resource images, which are not recolored.

property.name: recordBackdropColor
property.description-key: Hex color (e.g. #EDF3FB) painted behind the selected records icon and name, matching the faint colored chip the out-of-the-box Dataverse lookup field uses. Defaults to that same out-of-the-box color.

property.name: tooltipColumnName
property.description-key: Optional: logical name of a column on the target table whose value is shown as a tooltip when hovering over the currently selected record. Semicolon-separate multiple names (col1;col2) to try them in order per record - the first one with a value wins.

property.name: labelColumnName
property.description-key: Optional: logical name of a column on the target table to display as the label for each record, in the dropdown list and the selected value, instead of the primary name column. Semicolon-separate multiple names (col1;col2) to try them in order per record - the first one with a value wins.

property.name: searchColumns
property.description-key: Optional: comma-separated logical names of additional columns on the target table to search against, besides its primary name column (always searched).

property.name: sortColumnName
property.description-key: Optional: logical name of a column on the target table to sort search results by, always ascending. Both text and number columns are supported. Defaults to the primary name column when left blank.

property.name: additionalDisplayColumns
property.description-key: Optional: semicolon-separated logical names of columns on the target table to show as smaller context text underneath each record name in the dropdown list (not the selected value). Every listed column value is shown, not a fallback chain. Every column type is supported - Choice/Status/State show their label, Lookup/Owner/Customer show the referenced record name, Currency shows the formatted amount, dates and numbers use their formatted display value.

property.name: showInactiveRecords
property.description-key: If false (default), search results only include active records. If true, inactive records are included too.

property.name: resultLimit
property.description-key: Maximum number of matching records fetched and shown per search - re-queried from the server on every search, not a client-side page size.

property.name: componentHeight
property.description-key: Set the height of the lookup component

property.name: placeholderText
property.description-key: Placeholder text shown when no record is selected.
